name: Multi-Docker-Eval
abstract: Multi-Docker-Eval studies automatic environment building for software engineering agents. This page uses F2P under the SWE-Builder setting.
method: This work extends software-engineering evaluation beyond code edits to the automatic construction of runnable environments.
Multi-Docker-Eval measures whether models can bring diverse repositories into a test-ready state across languages and setups.
The results show that environment building remains a major bottleneck for agentic software engineering, with large differences in success rate and cost.

metrics.name: F2P
metrics.note: First-to-pass rate on the SWE-Builder framework.

leaderboard_note: The leaderboard uses F2P (%) under the SWE-Builder setting to reflect environment-building success.
